tagline: America's largest discount retailer by store count, serving value-conscious customers across 48 U.S. states and Mexico.
hero_kpi_rationale: Dollar General is the largest discount retailer in the United States by number of stores. Its growth is directly tied to the expansion of its network of 20,959 locations, a key indicator of its proximity and accessibility strategy for fixed- or low-income customers.
company_description: Dollar General Corporation, a discount retailer, provides various merchandise products in the southern, southwestern, midwestern, and eastern United States. It offers consumable products, including paper towels, bath tissues, paper dinnerware, trash and storage bags, disinfectants, and laundry products; packaged food, such as cereals, pasta, canned soups, canned meats, fruits and vegetables, condiments, spices, sugar, and flour; and perishables, including milk, eggs, bread, refrigerated and frozen food, beer, wine, and produce; candy, cookies, crackers, salty snacks, and carbonated beverages; over-the-counter medicines and personal care products including soap, body wash, shampoo, cosmetics, dental hygiene and foot care products; pet supplies and pet food; and tobacco products. kpis.signal: Total assets of €30.96 billion in the latest year.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.summary: Cybersecurity is a critical risk for the company, which must protect customer information, point-of-sale systems, and supply chain management data.
risks.score_rationale: The company highlights cybersecurity as a major risk, with regular audits and assessments to validate the effectiveness of its controls. The Audit Committee actively oversees risks related to data, cybersecurity, and AI. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Macroeconomic and Inflation
risks.summary: Inflation and macroeconomic uncertainties directly impact customer purchasing behavior and the company's operating margins.
risks.score_rationale: The company primarily serves fixed- or low-income customers who are particularly sensitive to inflation, unemployment rates, government policies, and tariffs. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Tariffs
risks.summary: Current and potential tariffs on imports could increase sourcing costs and necessitate price increases for customers.
risks.score_rationale: The tariff environment is dynamic and unpredictable. While tariffs had no material impact in 2025, announced tariffs could significantly affect costs and customer behavior. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Competition
risks.summary: Intensifying competition pressures pricing, margins, and market share, particularly from e-commerce and other discount retailers.
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive market with numerous players offering similar products and services, including e-commerce. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Labor Costs
risks.summary: Rising labor costs and talent retention challenges, especially at the store manager level, pose a risk to profitability.
risks.score_rationale: Increases in minimum wages, inflation in labor costs, and high managerial turnover significantly impact operating costs and profitability. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Performance of Existing Stores
risks.summary: High shrinkage and damages affect margins, although progress was made in 2025.
risks.score_rationale: The company is working to improve performance at mature stores, including reducing inventory shrinkage and damages, but these initiatives do not guarantee success. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Reputation and Compliance
risks.summary: Reputation is important to maintain customer and business partner trust.
risks.score_rationale: The company's reputation depends on its ability to serve customers responsibly while complying with increasing government regulations. (default score, to be refined)

ai_positioning.summary: The company did not meaningfully mention AI or machine learning in the provided excerpts from its 10-K report. AI is briefly referenced in the context of cybersecurity and data risk management, but without details on operational or strategic use.
evidence: Brief mention of AI in cybersecurity and data risk management

events.body: TTD beat revenue estimates as AI launches, strategic partnerships and strong CTV growth drove momentum despite an EPS miss.
